reviews.text: I have been a long time client at Kensifton Veterinary Hospital, 15+ years. All of the staff are outstanding and the Veterinary staff is superb!

Hot take, but absolutely not. From someone that spends half their life in doctors offices and has lived across eight states for health related reasons, I know when a cold shoulder means calling to ask for an invoice is going to be met with attitude.

The AI charade at the beginning is giving “extra” and “look we figured out how to use a software we bought that were locked into a contract with”—it’s all a bit “you can’t sit with us”.

She had made up her mind but instead of just ignoring the inquiry she left a long and detailed message educating on and mansplaining specialists.

I was told, in other words, by an actual ice queen Disney villain, that my service Labrador was too complicated, and while I said I needed someone to stitch together the pieces she moaned and ughed and sighed while asking me which specialists I’d been to then told me I was better off going to the ER and Urgent Card? Forever.

Continued to repeat the ER is not continuous care and specialists I’ve met treat patients like number, but then I realized she has a quota too.

Whatever her name was, was fully obnoxious, didn’t ask a single question, didn’t sympathize at all—“just think you shouldn’t wait three weeks, you should go to urgent care,” you should try this hospital and that hospital.

They don’t see service dogs with diarrhea, stomach issues, acid reflux and they can’t run tests or they just don’t want to do an intake.

Just tell me you don’t want take my service Labrador because you vets are too lazy to write notes and your vets only treat ear infections. They can’t come up with theories, run basic tests you’ve given them in a post, and you don’t feel like doing an intake, or you’re hangry and don’t want to put another patient into your system.

You’ve never heard a desperate exhausted handler of a medically trained service Labrador, who been up for nights for a two week infection. New to vet medicine?

If you want vaccines, nail clippings, anal gland expressions, deals with diarrhea,  some amox clav,  a pack of steroids, and maybe a three view X-Ray, only to be sold a tiny overpriced medicated shampoo you’ll never use with a big old bag of royal canine while a woman behind the desk judges you, and compares your dog to her dogs….this is the place for you. No way.

I wouldn’t bring my dog to a factory who won’t ask a single question before they reject you.

I take my dogs, Bobo and Doby, here! I always receive exceptional care from this clinic! Dr. Hayes is super informative and knowledgeable. I know Doby can be a little feisty, but she still shows so much attentiveness and care towards his old self. Thank you for everything you guys do!

I have been taking my pets to this veterinary office for four years. I stopped taking my dog there because I didn’t feel that the diagnosis and recommendations were correct, that was confirmed by a second doctor. I continued to take my cat because it is within walking distance from my home, and she doesn’t love car rides. I’ve seen a revolving door of practitioners and I believe a change of ownership but zero positive outcomes. The latest instance of frustration is an unclear unannounced policy regarding pet prescriptions. Apparently now if you go for a visit you have to make a second trip in to pick up you prescription because they don’t want to be inconvenienced even after spending hundreds of dollars on care. I work from 5 am to 9 pm for the next 5 days. I won’t go back, and I recommend going literally anywhere else.

I took my cat here to get a second opinion after a tumor was found in their mouth and the vet had suggested we cut off part of her jaw. She would have died. She's still around two years later. I do not recommend going to this vet.

I submitted the new patient form online, tried calling to make an appointment with no answer, received an email a day later saying to call for an appointment, called again and left a voicemail...haven't heard back. I guess they're just THAT busy which makes me think they're overwhelmed with current patients and don't need/care about my business. I guess good for them!

Sooo I called another vet and was able to get an appointment scheduled over the phone within 5 minutes.

I’ve been to quite a few vets with my dog and this was my first time at Kensington- the amount of care and attention Boba got during his check up was fantastic. You can tell the staff care about animals and really took the time to get to know my dog. Fair prices and looking forward to Kensington being our regular vet.

Update: Boba got his dental done today with an extraction and I was quite nervous because he’s my baby. Kensington made sure to give me regular updates and throughout the procedure and it was so reassuring. Dr. Rivard is amazing and all the staff are just wonderful. It’s been a year since we have started coming here and I am happy to say Kensington is our permanent veterinary practice.
Very kind and caring people

The entire staff from accounting, receptionists & veterinary doctors are amazing! They literally changed our dog Jagger’s life for the better. I can’t say enough good things about them. I highly recommend KVH to treat your dogs plus help keep them happy & healthy!

Wonderful fear free vets and tech staff. Always available for after care questions. I have a very nervous pup and they accommodate him the very best they can. I trust them implicitly with my 2 dogs and aging cat.

I used to take my dog to a large vet network and not only could I never get an appointment, but she hated it. I was so excited to get her into Kensington as a patient and even more excited during her first appointment when they sat on the ground giving her cookies to make her feel comfortable in the new environment. Now she LOVES going to the vet (even for jabs!). The Kensington staff is amazing, treating their patients with so much love and their fur parents with respect. Not only does the doctor email me a full summary of the appointment directly following it, but they also always check in the day after my dog receives a shot or procedure to see how she’s doing. These are such little things that go a long way in making me feel comfortable with my baby in their hands. Also, it is actually possible to get a same day appointment when I have an immediate health concern for my dog! Anytime a friend of mine is getting a pet I tell them to try to get into Kensington.

They close the office during lunch so good luck trying to contact them. I cannot get a hold of them and my pet is going downhill. You think after messages and multi calls they would call back and have some kind of urgency. Nope, out to lunch again. A bit of a pain to get in contact with, although the vet was very nice.
Dr Hayes and the entire staff are so kind and patient. I also am extremely grateful for the knowledge and care that Dr Hayes provided to my cat!
I've been going here since the '80s. Been through some changes in past couple of years. Not inexpensive. The Vets all seem knowledgeable and it's nice that they can confer on tough cases.
Fantastic care for my animal, clear communication from the front desk and the vets, would highly recommend for anyone in the area looking for care for their animal.

Canceled my appointment when I called and said we were going to be 10 minutes late due to another appointment being late ..for constantly making you wait in the lobby when you are on time they have a pretty poor grace period
Staff at Kensington vet are knowledgeable., polite, friendly and courteous. I am sorry I did not find them sooner, but very glad I finally did!!!

Outstanding b service and attention to your dogs needs no other vet could figure his allergies bout but Kennisigttin did .So happy they are available and easy to reach when we need them !Always make time for us Thank you Kensington!
Great service and all around great staff.
Very kind and thorough veterinary office.

The entire amazing and caring staff dropped everything they were doing to help our tragically injured cocker spaniel.  They spent the entire rest of their day, approximately 6 hours, fighting to save the life of our beloved little Alyssa.  At the last possible moment she regained some conscienceness so that we could take her to an emergency hospital in Sorrento Valley.  Unfortunately she did not survive, but their heroic efforts made it so that she was able to wake up to allow us to say "We love you"  and our goodbyes to our wonderful, 12 year old, baby girl.

Very accommodating and knowledgeable staff. From the phone to the many doctors there, my dog Teddy was always able to feel cared for and nothing was rushed or forced on us. Dr Rose was our primary doctor and she has been wonderful to work with. My dog doesn't warm up to many people but she has a way of gaining his trust and she takes the time to explain, in detail, what his problems are and how we can fix them. Her follow up is amazing. The best Vet I have ever worked with, hand down!

Last year, I took my senior kitty into see the vet due to her drinking a lot of water. She got her bloodwork done, and they said everything was fine. Some elevated kidney levels but that’s stress, and that she was really healthy and they couldn’t believe she was 16. I felt great!

I moved to Santee, so driving all the way to Kensington was just too far for my senior kitty. I went to a new vet. First thing thing the vet said after they introduced themselves,“I see her last vet visit had she had beginning stages of kidney disease, and high glucose. I’m a little worried that she wasn’t rechecked 90 days after.”

Kensington told me to recheck in a year. That she was healthy! That I didn’t need to worry. Fast forward 11 month later, and my cat is severely diabetic and with full kidney disease.

What’s frustrating is my concern and main reason I brought her into Kensington a year ago was that she was drinking a lot of water. So the signs say kidney issues, and I knew that. So why tell me all is fine? I was lead to feel like I was just being over protective.

If she now suffers at the end I will forever think about how much I dislike this vet.

Please just be transparent about everything. If you aren’t 100% sure if it’s stress or something else, then just say to retest sooner rather than later. If the pet parent doesn’t do that, that’s on them, but give us the choice. My girl was doing the pain shots and was at your office monthly for 6 months. She could have gotten blood work again.

We had a fantastic experience at Kensington! The staff was warm and incredibly helpful and answered all our questions about our newly adopted kittens. Our kittens were calm and at ease while in their appointment and you can tell it’s because of how much care the staff treated them with! We trust them to help us keep our cats happy and healthy the rest of their lives.

I recently switched veterinarians to Kensington Animal Hospital and they are wonderful. The front desk staff and techs are kind and helpful, and go the extra mile. Dr Junco was amazing and really takes his time and listens. I’m so happy to have found them

Dr Hayes and the entire team are excellent here. We are very grateful to have a vet that we trust and that our TimTam likes to come to. The care here is great and their concern for pets is extremely evident. We highly recommend coming here. The pricing is transparent and more than worth it for the level of care.

I must say... my dog is 2.5 years old and I've been going to KVH the entire time I've had Reese. As a new and first time pet owner... KVH makes everything a breeze. Not to mention, when necessary, they have ALWAYS been able to fit us in for a check up. They are flexible, kind and work with you. I don't feel like i'm being upsold on things just to do... but just REALLY cared for. Its very appreciated - thank you KVH!

Photo: Reese at the vet last week for tummy issues... promise she does love it. ha.

I took my dog to get carrier for the first time. I was told that I would be called the following morning to have a procedure done. No one ever called I waited and waited. Then finally I called after lunch never heard from anybody until about 3:30 yesterday. This saddens me as they knew that my dog was uncomfortable and it was disgusted this procedure would be done. They clearly do not care about animals and it's very sad. Shame on you for giving me false information and not following up as you should have. I also, left a message for the office manager who has yet to return a call. steer clear from here!!

Our family and dogs love Dr. Junco. He's the best! Great energy with our dogs and he provides us reliable, solid guidance and care for furry family members. KVH's staff is also very organized and has great communication at a time when that seems to be a challenge for other veterinarians.

Dr. Ronai cared about my cat Luc's needs, but he also listened to my financial limitations. So we agreed upon a treatment plan that accommodated both. (My previous vet did a lot of upselling and then gave me a guilt trip when I could not afford it.) Dr. Ronai was kind to both my pet and me. I know that Luc is in caring, excellent hands.

Dr Gossard & other vets, techs, & entire staff treat my pet & me like family. They're the best!

Recent visit: Dr Gossard is very professional, thorough, kind, knowledgeable, and a joy to work with.

Dr Seitz is amazing. She has been professional, extremely knowledgable, flexible, and caring while helping to stabilize our cats diabetes and reassuring our entire family for a couple of years now.
Dr Gossard has also been very supportive & knowledgable in helping us.
The entire staff has been wonderful.
Great, loving, smart, compassionate, understanding, attentive, patient, experienced vets. Slightly hidden and tight   but generally big enough parking lot accessible from Adams.
Always get great care from everyone on the team!
My highest expectations were exceeded.
My little puppy Flash loved his visit - Dr. Rose is kind and attentive - the staff so friendly.
Kensington Vet has taken excellent care of three dogs so far and do a wonderful job. Dr Tonya Gossard is so knowledgable and so sweet and manages to make our scaredy cat Hugo more comfortable.

All Dr. and vet techs are genuinely caring about the well being of your pet. I have never had a visit be anything short of amazing and have always been taken care of. The doctors personally email you after your visit to give you the summary of your visit and send links of recommendations of supplements for your animal.  I feel very lucky that this vet is in the neighborhood!

I have a rescue German Shepherd who is reactive. Dr. Junco took great care of us and got my reactive dog to approve of him!

13/10 Would recommend!

We are so grateful for KVH! We've been bringing our dog here for about 3 years and have consistently had wonderful experiences with the doctors, techs, and reception staff. We have full confidence in KVH and have felt so at ease with entrusting their team with our girl's health and well-being. Our pup recently got her dental cleaning done, and I was so impressed by the level of thoughtfulness and care that was taken. I was nervous for her to go under general anesthesia and received multiple updates from the team throughout the day, letting me know she was okay before and after her cleaning. We were even presented with the most adorable "Brave Patient Award" when we picked her up (courtesy of the amazing tech, Lindsay)! We could not recommend this practice more!

We love KVH!  Whether its our super friendly, people-loving pup who thinks going to the vet is a playdate, or our super nervous, cautious pup who is terrified and works on her best statue impression, KVH always makes us feel welcome and well cared for. We love that you offer alternative therapies like accupuncture and we very much appreciate that it's fairly easy to make appointments and be seen in a timely manner, especially when there's a concern. From the front desk staff, to the vet techs, and doctors everyone makes us feel like family and the care provided is top notch.  Thanks KVH, we love you!
Short wait , honest vet , great customer service.
Great team, great service and have been with KBH for 12 years.
Wonderful care and service. Everyone is extremely friendly and professional. The little touches and their communication through the app and text are top notch.
Bet Vets in Town. Brought my baby out of some pretty situations!

I took my cat Jonesy in for his first visit and the staff was wonderful! I didn't feel pressured to get any unnecessary vaccines or treatments. Communication has been easy and they're in a very convenient location for me. It seemed like the staff there genuinely cared about my little guy and gave me plenty of time and opportunity to ask any questions I had.
Great service with much caring.
Our Boone was always well cared for at Kensington! We appreciate all you do to care for our furry family members!

Positive, happy, helpful ladies at the front desk…so refreshing! Dr. Hayes is the kind of doctor I pray for. Kind, efficient, great listener and smart! She goes above and beyond for my two pups. I absolutely trust her and I’m very cynical.

Lost my fur baby in a hit and run over a year ago, so it’s taken me awhile to write this review. The vet techs were so kind and caring. Only got 4 stars bc would’ve loved to have more memorabilia options upon pet cremation. I received a wooden box with ashes, a paw print, and some fur. Very kind staff ❤️ (ps my little guy was not a client and they still helped me during this extremely devastating & numbing time)

Kensington Vet is fabulous.  They respond quickly to inquiries and get me and my cat in, quickly, always.  My cat Cresta has chronic kidney disease (recently diagnosed once we changed vets to Kensington).  The docs and the techs at K Vet are compassionate and could not be more caring.  Dr. Mason is retired but I was lucky enough to meet her and she treated Cresta originally at K Vet but since she retired, we've seen a couple of the techs who been wonderful in helping me learn how to administer fluids to Cresta and reminding me of the importance of giving Cresta her special CKD diet and meds.  I don't think my cat would still be alive and living a good life if it weren't for K Vet and their great staff.  A shout out to Paula, Elizabeth and Kristina and thank you for all you do.
The staff was super friendly and you can definitely see that they all love what they do , that is very important to me . My babies will receive nothing but the best care
Out standing ❤❤

Dr Gossard is amazing.
Elizabeth and Paula go out of their way to help.
The receptionist there was very welcoming and friendly. The veterinarian was very helpful and nice to my tiny little dog. I will continue to take Dexter there forever!

The folks at Kensington Veterinary Hospital are always so thoughtful and caring. Dr. Gossard added an extra appointment to the start of her day to see Pepper. They always go over all of the options and costs and confirm that it is something I can financially undertake before proceeding. I trust that they are not suggesting unnecessary procedures. Pepper is always so well loved. I am so grateful.
Great place to bring your Pets. Docter is great and staff is amazing. Clean office too. Very compassionate. We found our new Vet for sure. Thanks for helping Milo and Apollo get better!

I can not say enough good things about the great care our pets receive at Kensington Veterinary Hospitals. When my husband and I met, we had six animals between the two of us! Each pet has been given wonderful care. They were very supportive when our dog was diagnosed with skin cancer, by our side every step of the way with guidance and support through the process. When our new kitten developed a deadly disease they guided us to providers who diagnosed and they cheered us on as we undertook a lengthy treatment plan. Now our older cat has developed diabetes, the help and support as we manage has been amazing. After hour calls to update us and reassure us, the kindness of the staff and doctors is amazing.
This vet treats you like family- they know my dog and love my dog. Great service- great vet. I highly recommend.

Our family cats have been patients at Ken Vet for decades. They have always received the best and gentlest care, with referrals to excellent specialists whenever needed. All the vets and staff are kind, conscientious, and professional. We are lucky to have them in our community.
Very good with Liana! always able to accommodate and timely! I’ve NEVER had a issue the whole year i’ve been bringing my pup!
